purpose: A surface that groups related content, with header, body and footer, plus Stat for a single figure and its trend.

supplied: an interactive card is a real button or link, not a div with a click handler
the trend on Stat is given as text as well as a direction and colour
the loading state renders placeholder bars announced as loading
required: `href` or `interactive`, never a bare onClick on the surface — otherwise it is unreachable by keyboard
a heading that names the group, where the card is a section of a page

composition.notes: An interactive card must not contain its own buttons or links: a control inside a clickable surface is a nested interactive element, and neither target is predictable.

safeMutations.rationale: Surface styling is safe. `href` and `interactive` decide what the card *is*, and `value` and `trend` are the figure it reports.

propNotes.interactive: Makes the whole surface a button. Do not combine with controls inside it.
propNotes.trend: Stat only. The direction is also stated in text, so it survives being read aloud.
